sentiment.label: risk_off
sentiment.reason_it: Il VIX a 16,49 indica un mercato poco difensivo, ma l'S&P 500 è sceso del -0,48% e il DXY è leggermente più forte a 98,81 (+0,04%). Il TLT 20Y è in calo del -0,57% (tassi in rialzo) e il rendimento del 10Y USA è salito al 4,83% (+0,65%). L'aumento del Brent a $102,35 (+1,13%) e la pressione geopolitica in Ucraina e sull'Iran confermano un bias bearish, spingendo il sentiment verso risk‑off.
sentiment.reason_en: The VIX at 16.49 signals low defensive posture, yet the S&P 500 fell by -0.48% and the DXY edged higher to 98.81 (+0.04%). The 20‑year TLT dropped by -0.57% (rates rising) and the US 10Y yield rose to 4.83% (+0.65%). Brent climbed to $102.35 (+1.13%) while geopolitical tension in Ukraine and Iran adds bearish pressure, steering sentiment to risk‑off.

Crypto: BTC -1,34% e ETH -1,02% riflettono pressione dal rialzo del petrolio e dalle tensioni geopolitiche.

articles.title: The Strange Transformation of the Front Line in Ukraine
articles.snippet: On Jan. 5, 2025, my volunteer platoon attached to the 23rd Special Purpose Battalion of the Presidential Brigade entered a 1-kilometer-long tree line called CHAI, on the outskirts of Kotlyne, a few kilometers west of Pokrovsk, Ukraine. Our task was to occupy a position whose status on DeepState, an open-source map tracking military operations in the Russo-Ukrainian war, had been shifting out of gray for five days. On DeepState’s map, different colors illustrate the fighting situation: the red area is held by the aggressor, while green or blue areas show territory successfully defended or recaptured by the Ukrainian army. This has now changed with the latest escalation in the chokepoint, sending Brent crude above $100 per barrel on Wednesday morning.
